label: Bible Study
prompt: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more _____ way.
verse: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
note: Paul's bridge into the love chapter — 'a more excellent way' turns the page to chapter 13.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be _____.
verse: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
note: The prophet Azariah to King Asa: don't let your hands go weak — your work shall be rewarded.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side _____.
verse: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
note: Blind Bartimaeus sat begging by the Jericho roadside — and he was about to make a lot of noise.

label: Deep Water
prompt: On that night could not the king _____, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
verse: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
note: One sleepless night, one boring chronicle, and Mordecai's forgotten good deed comes to light — God is unnamed but busy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There is therefore now no _____ to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verse: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
note: After Romans 7's wrestling, chapter 8 opens with the verdict: 'no condemnation' for those in Christ Jesus.
